items.title: Bitcoin stolen from Binance tops Tesla’s holdings and is over twice El Salvador’s reserve
items.snippet: The 18,270 BTC haul is worth about $1.4 billion and comes within 442 coins of SpaceX’s disclosed holdings. Blockchain investigators link the attack to North Korea.
items.note: Негативний тон для BTC за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: OpenAI reportedly cuts fundraising and valuation targets amid AI jitters
items.snippet: Anxiety about the AI boom has sent the Nasdaq 100 slumping by about 10% in just three weeks since hitting a record high on October 6, including a 4.5% drop on Friday.
items.note: Позитивний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами.
